basis: Researcher confirmed that the first ten InsightBench cases were inspected during AI-assisted development.

rules.dev-contaminated: Debugging and regression only; excluded from generalization claims.
rules.source-valid: May guide whether an implementation is retained; cannot be promoted to source-test later.
rules.source-test: Must be frozen before first use and cannot guide further method changes.
rules.target-test: Must not guide prompts, skills, budgets, or system changes.
